ultimate.name: Living Shadow
ultimate.text: Your first crossing each reveal grants 2 Block instead.

heroes.name: Friar Franc
heroes.traitText: Resolve a Basic first: your second Hero or Fury card gets +1 damage on its first hit.
heroes.weakness: The finisher still needs Range. Your first card reveals your setup.
heroes.combo: Wind Up → Last Orders: a plain Basic turns into a 7-damage finisher.

rules: Pick two. Keep them secret.
Click two cards in order. Click again to return one. Confirm to lock your plan. You and your rival reveal the first pair together, then the second.
Read the reveal. Throw a surprise.
After a pair flips, each player can throw one Loot or save it. Both choices lock before the Loot is shown. Loot resolves in Edge order, before the cards.
Speed decides who acts first.
Higher Speed resolves its entire card first. Edge wins ties. Check Range when the Attack actually happens. A knockout ends the fight immediately.
Choose movement when it happens.
Click a glowing arena space. Stay put, move either direction, or pass through your rival. You cannot finish on their space. Push and pull distances are also optional choices.
Walls hurt. Block is brief.
A push beyond space 1 or 7 stops at the wall and adds 1 damage. Block caps at 6 and clears after each reveal. Helga keeps it for the second reveal, then clears it.
Basics buy the ridiculous stuff.
Each Basic grants 1 Coin after resolving, even on a miss. Coins cap at 8. Between plans, buy one blind Loot for 3 Coins or save. Hold at most two.
Getting hit builds Fury.

Gain 1 Fury per opposing card that damages you, not per Health point. At 3, your special card enters your hand once and cycles through your deck afterward. At 5, your Hero’s permanent Fury ability turns on. Full Block and self-damage grant none.
Simple Hero tricks.

Health and Block payments are optional and chosen at resolution. Health payments must leave you alive. Raven tracks crossing for this round only. Franc needs a resolved Basic first, then a Hero or Fury card second. Wind Up and Long Reach expire at the end of the round.
Keep the fight moving.
After both reveals, refill to five and flip Edge. Empty purchase windows skip. At the end of round 10, both lose 2 Health. Sudden Death increases by 1 each later round, ignoring Block.
Build your fighting style.

Choose 10 Basics and 5 Hero cards, at most two copies per design. Quick Play uses a suggested draft; Randomize gives another legal deck. Six Heroes, each with eight draftable moves and a Fury card. Suggested decks are ready to play. Your opening hand always includes a Hero card.
